crossRefs.note: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth…
Jethro said, “Blessed be Yahweh, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of…
Blessed be Yahweh, the God of our fathers, who has put such a thing as this in the king’s heart, to beautify Yahweh’s…
As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.
Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.
Praise be to Yahweh God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
“Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people;
But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.

people.name: Abigail
people.line: Wife of Nabal, later married David

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: David said to Abigail, “Blessed is Yahweh, the God of Israel, who sent you today to meet me!
translations.bsb: Then David said to Abigail, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who sent you to meet me this day!
translations.kjv: And David said to Abigail, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which sent thee this day to meet me:
translations.asv: And David said to Abigail, Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, who sent thee this day to meet me:
